Core Visual Identity & Concept * **Aesthetic Keywords:** Soft 3D, Claymorphism, Matte Plastic, Modern Tech UI, Friendly, Playful, Minimalist, Tactile, Levitating/Floating. * **Overall Feel:** Clean, approachable, smooth, premium app/web illustration aesthetic. * **Level of Realism:** Stylized & Abstracted 3D (Non-photorealistic, toy-like tactile realism).  ---  ## 2. Geometry & Shape Language * **Edge Treatment:** **Extremely rounded corners and soft bevels.** No sharp 90-degree angles anywhere. Every corner has a thick, smooth radius. * **Volume & Form:** Objects are plump, slightly inflated, thick, and pillow-like (chubby geometry). * **Simplification:** Shapes are reduced to their simplest geometric representation. Complex details are abstracted into smooth, rounded blocks or lines. * **Layering:** Elements are layered on top of each other with distinct depth separation (e.g., floating cards over background shapes).  ---  ## 3. Surface Finish & Materiality * **Material Type:** Smooth matte clay, soft-touch silicone, or unglazed smooth plastic. * **Reflectivity / Gloss:** Very low specular reflection. No harsh shiny highlights, no mirror reflections, and **zero metallic properties**. * **Texture:** Perfectly smooth surfaces with a soft, uniform sheen that gently catches light. * **Transparency:** 100% opaque materials; no glass, refraction, or transparency.  ---  ## 4. Lighting & Shading * **Light Source:** Soft, highly diffused studio lighting coming consistently from the top-front-left. * **Graduation:** Smooth, seamless color gradients across curved surfaces to define volume and subtle depth without harsh lighting breaks. * **Highlights:** Soft, wide light falls across rounded edges; no sharp pin-point highlights. * **Contrasts:** Low to medium lighting contrast. Shadows are soft and light, avoiding deep blacks or harsh shadows.  ---  ## 5. Shadows & Depth * **Drop Shadows:** Long, highly blurred, soft-edged drop shadows cast directly onto the surface below floating elements. * **Ambient Occlusion:** Soft, subtle darkening where two shapes touch or layer over one another to create visual dimension. * **Shadow Color:** Tinted shadows (soft purple, muted blue, or light pink grey) matching the ambient color scheme, never pure black.  * **Levitation / Floating:** The final icon must NEVER sit flat on the surface. It always levitates slightly above the ground plane with a small gap between the object and the surface below. A soft, diffused shadow is cast directly beneath the icon on the surface, reinforcing the floating effect — exactly as shown in the reference example (checklist clipboard floating above pink background with soft shadow underneath).
---  ## 6. Color Palette & Harmony * **Primary Tones (Backgrounds & Large Surfaces):** White or very light neutral backgrounds only. * **Accent Tones (Interactive / Pop Elements):** Vibrant yet soft pastel accents—mint green, butter/mustard yellow, warm coral, turquoise, and deep purple. * **Neutrals:** Clean white backgrounds for all icons and illustrations. * **Color Relationship:** High pastel saturation with balanced, low-contrast harmony.  ---  ## 7. Composition & Camera Angles * **Framing / Viewpoint:** **3/4 Isometric or slight Perspective view**, angled slightly from above looking down. * **Subject Positioning:** Primary subject floats centrally in mid-air above a flat background plane. * **Background Style:** Clean, flat solid pastel background OR very gentle, seamless pastel gradient (top-to-bottom). * **Secondary Accents:** Optional floating 3D accent particles around the main subject (e.g., soft 4-point star sparkles, floating spheres, or small geometric bubbles).  ---
